Schema

Four related tables.

Revenue = quantity × unit_price, for completed orders only. All amounts are CAD before tax; refunds, discounts, and tax are not modelled.

How the tables connect

customers.id → orders.customer_id

orders.id → order_items.order_id

products.id → order_items.product_id

The dataset is fictional and fixed to January–September 2026.

Getting started

Querywise turns a question into read-only SQL, runs it against the connected source, and shows the actual results. This hosted page runs a sample SQLite database in your browser.

  1. Start the projectdocker compose up --buildOpen http://localhost:8000. Sample questions work immediately.
  2. Choose a modelSettings → AI provider: paste an Anthropic API key, or use a local Ollama model (ollama pull qwen2.5:7b). Keys are encrypted locally and never shown again in full.
  3. Connect your dataSettings → Data sources: PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle, Db2, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Excel/CSV or Parquet. Querywise tests the connection, then discovers every table and column.
  4. AskThe model sees the schema and your question, never row data. SQL is validated against the source’s tables and runs read-only.

Settings

Connecting tests the source first, then discovers its tables. Questions and the table allowlist use that schema.

Add a connection

Secrets are encrypted in the local app-state database and never sent back to the browser. Environment variables override saved values and lock the matching field. Only the schema and your question go to the AI provider, never row data.
